text:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: HIGH — suspicious outbound auth headers observed in external log sink from private runtime redwood-private-prod-1. Matching pattern: Authorization: Bearer <token-frag>. Paging on-call.
elena_sre: Oncall here. Confirming alert. Which svc emitted the logs? I see repeated forwards from log-forwarder-1.
matt_backend: log-forwarder-1 pushed to analytics.thirdparty.example.com around 2026-03-17T22:12:34Z. Quick grep:
```
$ jq -r '.headers.Authorization' /var/log/forwarder/outbound.log | head
"Bearer eyJhbGciOiJ...abcd"
```
sara_cs: Customer (acme-corp) DM'd support with screenshot of tokens in third-party dashboard. They've asked for immediate mitigation and a timeline.
jordan_security: Agreed P1. Immediate actions: 1) block egress to analytics endpoint 2) rotate service account keys used by log-forwarder 3) revoke any exposed tokens 4) preserve forensic snapshot. Who can block egress now?
elena_sre: Applying firewall deny rule: `fwctl apply block-analytics-2026 --dst analytics.thirdparty.example.com` (running now).
devops_bot: DeployBot: Firewall rule block-analytics-2026 applied by elena_sre at 2233334550. Rule ID fw-89b7.
matt_backend: Starting hotfix to strip Authorization header in forwarder. Patch pushed: https://git.internal/redwood/log-forwarder/commit/abc123. Rolling restart set to 3 instances at a time.
elena_sre: Taking snapshot of affected host logs and disk image for forensics: saved to secure S3 path s3://redwood-forensics/2233334444-snapshot.tar.gz (access restricted).
jordan_security: We need to rotate the long-lived service account keys ASAP. svcacct: svc-logs-forwarder-prod. @devops_bot can you create rotation ticket and enqueue key swap with KMS?
devops_bot: Ticket created: INF-4521 - rotate keys for svc-logs-forwarder-prod. Assigned to devops oncall. ETA 30m.
sara_cs: Messaging customer ack: "We've applied an immediate egress block and are rotating affected keys. No evidence of data exfil beyond log lines; we'll follow up with timeline in 1 hour." Sending now.
matt_backend: Hotfix rolled to all instances at 2233334800, header-stripping confirmed in staging tests. Example new header content: `Authorization: <redacted>`.
ejordan_security: Initiating token revocation: invalidate session tokens issued in the last 24h where issuer=log-forwarder. Command run against auth-api at 2233334905.
elena_sre: Notifying SOC and Legal. Legal wants customer-facing language approved before escalation. Adding legal@ to thread.
mike_sre: Night oncall taking over for live mitigation. I'm up to speed — will monitor ACL hits, confirm key rotation complete, and coordinate customer follow up. @elena_sre handing off.
elena_sre: Handoff notes: actions taken so far: firewall block applied, hotfix deployed to strip headers, forensic snapshot saved, rotation ticket created INF-4521, tokens revoked. Watchlist: analytics.thirdparty.example.com outgoing attempts, log-forwarder restarts.
mike_sre: Ack. I'll run continuous watch for 4h and update every 30m or on change. First check in 2233335123.
sara_cs: Thanks team — drafting post-incident note for customer with timeline and next steps. Will attach when legal approves.
PagerBot: Incident channel auto-note: status=P1, mitigations=egress-block+key-rotation+hotfix, owner=mike_sre, ticket=INF-4521.
__notes: Single-thread Slack export; messages are chronological. No title field as per agents.md.
